en: Vintage color postcard divided into two main images. On the left is a statue of a man standing on a tall pedestal overlooking the water, with bollards and a quay in the foreground; the caption beneath reads "STATUE DE FERDINAND DE LESSEPS." On the right is a harbor scene with ships, quays, and low waterfront buildings; the caption reads "PORT-SAID. VUE ET PORT DE PORT-SAID." Decorative foliage separates the images. There is handwritten cursive text across the bottom and left margins and a date written at the top left.
